summary: Implemented large parts of the statsmodels skeleton: tsa deterministic terms and DeterministicProcess, AutoReg (fit, predict, summary, apply/append, order selection), iolib Summary/summary_params tables, discrete-model likelihoods and results basics, stattools, proportion, weightstats, arima_process, graphics utils and prediction results, plus base/data/compat fixes. Last complete full-suite run I saw: 5285 passed, 11636 failed or errored of 17667; later fixes were not re-measured because the suite no longer finishes under shared load (discrete tests alone exceed 15 min).
